facts.text: The hotel is in the heart of Center City, steps from Rittenhouse Square and Philadelphia City Hall.
facts.excerpt: In the heart of Center City, Kimpton Hotel Palomar Philadelphia is steps from Rittenhouse Square and Philadelphia City Hall.

facts.text: The hotel is housed in a converted 1920s building.
Installations of pinwheels made from blueprints decorate the hotel, alongside local artists' pieces.
facts.excerpt: with installations of pinwheels made from blueprints and metal figurines scaling a wall like an army of construction workers

facts.text: The lobby has design touches such as pop art busts of Benjamin Franklin and ceramic roller skates.
facts.excerpt: quirky design touches such as pop art busts of Benjamin Franklin, ceramic roller skates

facts.text: The hotel has a LEED Gold sustainability certification.
Square 1682 serves creative cocktails with hearty cuisine and produce from a rooftop garden.
facts.excerpt: Creative cocktails paired with straight forward, hearty cuisine and fresh-grown produce from our rooftop garden.

facts.text: Pets are welcome regardless of size, weight or breed, at no extra charge.
facts.excerpt: We invite you to bring your pet no matter their size, weight, or breed, all at no extra charge.

facts.text: The hotel provides pet beds and food and water bowls free of charge.
facts.excerpt: We provide beds and food/water bowls for your pet companion on a complimentary basis.

facts.text: Spa Rooms come with a deep soaking Fuji tub and a standalone shower.
facts.excerpt: Each of our 19 Spa Rooms comes with a deep soaking Fuji tub, standalone shower, bathroom with a view

facts.text: In the evening, staff host guests over complimentary wine or hot toddies, depending on the season.
facts.excerpt: chatting up guests over complimentary wine or hot toddies in the evening—depending on the season

facts.text: Parking is by valet, for a fee.
facts.excerpt: Valet parking is available at a charge of $71.05 for overnight and $43.20 for day parking.

facts.text: The hotel has no local area shuttle.
facts.excerpt: There is no local area shuttle available at this hotel.

facts.text: EV charging spaces are available on a first-come, first-served basis.
facts.excerpt: Charging spaces are available on a first-come, first-served basis.
